overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating unlearning methods through both behavioral tests (QA and text completion) and intrinsic parametric analysis. Automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE) are used to evaluate the generated outputs. GPT-4 is used for data preparation but not as a judge of the outputs. The extraction was generally accurate, requiring only minor normalization and clarification.
